title: Shella Betel Vine Planters' Air (Rwai Sla-Tympew)
cultural_context: Celebrates the golden paddy harvest in the terrace valleys. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
Ynda wan ka por ba bet ia u kba,
Ki nongrep ki kmen ban trei;
Na sngi sha sngi da ka jinghok,
Ban bsa ia la ka kur ka jait.
lyrics_english:
When the season of paddy sowing arrives,
The cultivators joyfully till the fertile earth;
From sunrise to sunset in righteousness,
To nourish and sustain their matrilineal clan.
